Note: Most underlined verbs are in 'ed' forms; these are called regular verbs and the rest which do not take 'ed' are called irregular verbs
The past form and the past participle form of regular verbs endin'ed' But irregular verbs make their past simple and past participle forms in an irregular way For example:
work, worked, worked (regular)
g০, went, gone (irregular)
But you should note the following points:
1. Some verbs can be both regular and irregular For example:
learn) learned, learned learn, learnt, learnt
2. Some verbs change their meaning depending on whether they are regular 01 irregular ; for example "to hang":
